verdict: Sweetened Kopi O has about half the calories of teh tarik. Teh tarik is still fine, especially if you ask for less sweet.
why: Teh tarik is about 120 kcal a glass, sweetened Kopi O around 60 kcal.
Teh tarik has a little protein (3 g) from milk, but not enough to keep you full.
Teh tarik has about 4 g fat from condensed milk, Kopi O has almost no fat.
2 glasses of teh tarik a day is already around 240 kcal. Easy to overlook because it's 'just a drink'.
when_a: Teh tarik is okay as a 'reward' glass during lepak, or ask for 'kurang manis' (less sweet).
when_b: Kopi O suits a daily morning or afternoon drink at the office.
tip: Ask for 'kurang manis' (less sweet) or 'kosong' (no sugar). Over time, your taste buds will get used to less sweetness.

faq.q: Is Kopi O kosong even better?
faq.a: Yes, Kopi O kosong has almost no calories. If you're not used to it, start with less sweet first.

faq.q: Can I drink teh tarik every day?
faq.a: Yes, if it still fits your daily calories. Limit it to one glass a day and ask for less sweet.
